title: Calendar on a Mac
body:
Once upon a time, when you entered a new event into your calendar, the default was “All Day“. If you wanted to input a particular start time, one click and you could choose the time you wanted. This made good sense. 
Then for some reason, without asking or telling us, Apple decided to reverse this, and give every event a start time automatically. Problem: 99.9999% of the time, the start time one might want is NOT the start time allocated, meaning you have to make a change, either to another specific time or to All Day. 
It really peeves me me that there is not at least an option to make “All Day“ a default option!
Piece of advice that Apple would do well to take on board: Give us what we actually want in terms of options, instead of dictating only one option that you think we want when you have no idea what we actually want!
Consult widely (worldwide) before making changes. 
What the average, ordinary, everyday user wants often bears no resemblance to what an Apple geek wants and therefore incorrectly assumes we all want. 
Think of the everyday customer, the majority, not just geeks!
